description: Rename an HTML page or site: the title shown in the gallery, profile, search and link cards. Works when the publication's owner token is in a BrewPage profile (free sign-in at https://account.brewpage.app). The new title stays when you republish. Link unchanged.

ownerToken.description: Owner token from create. Default: env BREWPAGE_OWNER_TOKEN (local server only).

title.description: New title, 1-200 characters, one line. Empty string: back to the title from the content. Omit: show the current title.

name: set_title
title: Rename page or site
